question_text: READING(DeviceID, SensorID, Timestamp, DeviceName, Value) has the composite key (DeviceID, SensorID, Timestamp). DeviceID alone determines DeviceName. Outline why the relation violates 2NF.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: DeviceName depends on only DeviceID, a proper subset of the composite key. This partial dependency of a non-key attribute violates 2NF.

marking_points.criterion: Identifies DeviceName depending on DeviceID only.
Explains partial dependency on part of the composite key.
